items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: His name was Lamar. See, but he took the name because he wanted to be right along with us.

ctx.x: How come that the—Gellarrow changed—he evidently took that name then. He took it—he named it—
His name was Lamar. See, but he took the name because he wanted to be right along with us. My mother wanted it that way, though. Mm-hmm.
But then he put the R in there, changed the spelling, huh? Yeah, he changed it— Somebody did. To Americanize the name.
